channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman turns $20 scratch-off into $5 million jackpot
item.description: A St. Lucie County woman hit a $5 million jackpot earlier this year from a scratch-off lottery ticket, Florida Lottery officials announced Friday. item.title: Boca Raton man arrested for soliciting videos from 14-year-old, Boynton Beach police seek additional victims
item.description: Maximiliano Buitrago of Boca Raton was arrested after allegedly asking a 14-year-old for videos in response to a Craigslist babysitting post.

item.title: Boynton Beach Fire Rescue saves dog from raw sewage lift station
item.description: Boynton Beach Fire Rescue Department firefighters rescued a dog that fell 10 to 12 feet into a lift station holding about 2 feet of raw sewage Thursday.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to New York JFK route in September
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Treasure Coast residents report avoiding lettuce amid E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks
item.description: Five confirmed cases of cyclospora have been reported locally since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies are implementing security measures two years in the making for Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPads to prevent AI use in game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions.

item.title: Photographer recalls baby Lamine Yamal bathed by teenage Messi ahead of World Cup final
item.description: Barcelona photographer Joan Monfort took photos of teenage Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal in 2007 for a charity calendar. The two now face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two late goals to defeat England 2-1 Wednesday and advance to the World Cup final, where they will face Spain on Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: St. Lucie Mets Edge Palm Beach 3-2 in Extra Innings
item.description:

item.title: Boca Raton B'nai Torah Congregation TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for Families
item.description: Families looking for ways to give back this summer can take part in the TLC Program at B'nai Torah Congregation, where volunteers help with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: State Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of September 21 on misdemeanor charges from her May sit-in outside the governor's office protesting Florida's congressional map.

item.title: Leon County jury orders Florida Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 in sexual harassment case
item.description: A Leon County jury found Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation Friday, ordering him to pay $450,000 to former legislative aide Nicolas Frevola, former intern Jacob Cutbirth and Frevola's mother. item.title: Vindman raises $8.5 million in Florida Senate race as special election heats up
item.description: Democrat Alex Vindman expanded his fundraising lead over rival Angie Nixon with $8.5 million raised in the second quarter, pushing total receipts above $16 million in the race for Marco Rubio's former seat.

item.title: South Florida residents avoid lettuce as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks spread
item.description: Thousands across the U.S. have been affected by contaminated produce outbreaks, with five confirmed local cyclospora cases in Palm Beach, St. Lucie and Martin counties since May.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels low-altitude Pensacola flyover despite safety concerns
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended a Blue Angels jet that flew so low over a crowded Pensacola beach Wednesday that chairs and tents went flying, marking the third time he has intervened in military flyover investigations.

item.title: Trump administration releases declassified records referencing Florida voter data collection
item.description: Declassified intelligence records show a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter-registration information from commercial websites in 2022, though the records do not say Florida ballots or vote totals were altered.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate Fishback faces court challenge over Florida residency requirement
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will defend his eligibility to remain in the primary next week as opponent Jay Collins argues records showing Fishback lived and voted in Washington, D.C., mean he does not satisfy Florida's seven-year residency requirement for governor.
